title: A recordless compliance service can't come due; closing two asks per record
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor with view customers (and edit customers to add or change a record), on the build under test.
  2. Open an asset page and its Maintenance tab (the last tab, after Notes). The asset card is on the left; the Compliance section sits below Contact.
  3. A compliance service on the asset with no record, and a work order closing two compliance inspections.
custom_steps:
1. Check whether the recordless compliance service can come due or appears in counts.
  2. On the work order closing two compliance inspections, see how details are requested.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A compliance service with no record cannot come due and is excluded from every count.
  • A work order closing two compliance inspections asks for details per record, not once for the work order.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
